name: Greased Floor
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-05: Silver Bark, Golden Blades
description: The floor is highly waxed and slippery.
disable: DC 14 Survival check or DC 14 Thievery check to remove the slippery coating or any ability that turns the area into difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slip and Slide
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the greased area

Effect The triggering creature must make a successful DC 12 Acrobatics check to avoid falling Prone. The area is uneven ground.
